text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: It was a wondrous moment.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
When the three converged near the<n>finish, they
each wanted time to stop<n>right there.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
But as if her fate was guided by the<n>alpha star
inscribed in her name, the<n>racer in blue crossed the
finish line,<n>spelling the end of that moment.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The name of that star was Admire<n>Vega.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Their goal should have been to cross<n>that line
quickly, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
If it were possible, they would have<n>stayed racing
in their shared moment<n>forever.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
The battle of the Classics has come<n>at last. Leading
off is the first race in<n>the series, the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Today we have with us the first,<n>second and third
favorites to win the<n>race. It's the trio on
everyone's lips,<n>BNW!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... I'm so nervous it's making<n>me itchy...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm not used to you being so quiet.It's making me nervous!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Deep breaths... nice and slow.

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
I'd now like to begin today's press<n>conference
with the runners of the<n>Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I understand that the three of you are<n>good friends.
How do you feel facing<n>each other in the same
race?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When we entered the academy, we<n>talked about
racing together. Now that<n>the time's finally here,
it's rather<n>exciting.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Um... Same for me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, me too! Put me down as<n>samesies with
Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: C-copycats...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
The public has endearingly dubbed<n>the three of you
"BNW". Leading into<n>the Classics, what would you
like to<n>say to the public?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You two go first this time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: After you, Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wha, me?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uh... The... the BWH trio is gonna<n>make it big!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't "BWH" a set of<n>measurements?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Gaaaaagh! I messed it up!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I've never seen such a botched<n>press conference.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, sometimes we have to let Ticket<n>do her thing.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm still SO embarrassed just thinkingabout it!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ah! It's BNW!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
We just saw your press conference!<n>You're such
a joker, Tickezo!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I didn't do it on purpose!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
You were amazing in the Yayoi Sho! I<n>turned into a
total Tickezo fan after<n>that!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
For real?! Thanks! Keep watching,<n>I'm gonna win
the Satsuki Sho too!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Um, do you think I could get your<n>autographs?!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Me too, please!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, fine with you two, right? I just<n>got used to
signing my name!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Phew, that was a lot of signing!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's finally calmed down. I didn't think<n>a crowd
could form so quickly.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
And now we see who's most<n>popular. You were
signing nonstop,<n>huh?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I dunno if I'm happy or<n>embarrassed...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But every year, over a hundred<n>thousand fans
show up to see the<n>Derby, you know? I gotta be
able to<n>sign like the wind!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry? Don't tell me you're gonna<n>give autographs
to a hundred<n>thousand people.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I know it's impossible, but I wish I<n>could. Even in
that press conference,<n>I felt like I couldn't let all
those people<n>down.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
For all the autographs I can't sign, I<n>gotta give them
a race that'll make<n>them really happy!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, sometimes you say some<n>poignant things.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! Oh, yeah! You two wanna<n>take some
photos together to turn into<n>stickers?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We're about to start the Classics, so<n>it'd be like a
sign of our<n>determination!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Seems like kind of a weird way to<n>show that... But
sure, why not?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look, look! This booth makes<n>faces look smaller!
You're always<n>worried about how big your head is,
right, Hayahide?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I worry about the abundance of my<n>hair! Not the
size of my head!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, was that it? Whatever! Check it<n>out—you can
write stuff on the pics,<n>so let's put "Derby" on
there!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Why "Derby"?! The next race is the<n>Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Come on, it'll be fun! We're<n>gonna race
through the Classics<n>togetheeer!
